description: Resolve a place name to coordinates for use as the birth place of a Vedic chart. Call this first when the user gives a place name rather than latitude and longitude.

country.description: Optional country preference such as "in". Matching widens automatically when that country has no result.

q.description: Place name, for example "Noida" or "Darbhanga, Bihar".

title: Search birth place
